decision: 10 second time penalty imposed after the Race. 1 penalty point (total of 2 for the 12 month period).
fact: Car 43 failed to slow for a single yellow flag
offence: Breach of Article B1.8.4 a. of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 43 (Franco Colapinto), team representative and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. The Stewards determine that, albeit the driver of Car 43 slightly reduced speed before entering the single yellow flag zone, but did not discernibly reduce speed in the relevant yellow flag sector. The Stewards acknowledge that the driver reacted to the yellow flag but do not consider the reaction to be sufficient to comply with the regulations. Therefore a penalty on the lower end of the applicable scale of penalties is imposed.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 43 Failing To Slow For Yellow Flags
